Data Source Facts Label














Source Identity






Source name


Social Media and the Internet in the Trafficking of Humans (SMITH) Data Project




Domain/topic


Social Sciences




Source type


Public Dataset











Collection Context






Collector/producer


Organizition: Harvard Dataverse (public). Author: Spencer Brooke Hayes (refrence page included in coding guide).




Original purpose


Data set was created by author to use as evidence in a dissertation




Collection method


Public records: United Nations annual reports




Record-creation event


Event: Human traffiking incident reported to United Nations and landing on annual reports











Observation and Scope






Unit of observation


Human trafficking case




Population or objects represented


Human trafficking case details such as date, case number, country




Time period covered


2000-2023




Geographic area coverage


Member states of united nations











Variables and Data Structure






Main variables/fields


Country, use of social media, technology presence




Data types included


Categorical, numerical, year, case ID, binary, web link




Direct measurements


Date, country, internet/ social media/ techonoly presence




Possible proxy variables


NA











Documentation






Documentation found


Metadata, coding guide, abstract

Yes, dataset even includes link

title: Data Collection Facts Label
text:
Data Source Facts Label














Source Identity






Source name


The Counter Trafficking Data Collaborative




Domain/topic


Relationships between victims and perpetrators




Source type


Synthetic dataset











Collection Context






Collector/producer


International Organization for Migration




Original purpose


Develop and refine an algorithm to generate synthetic data from CTDC’s sensitive victim case records




Collection method


First-hand information on the relationships between victims and perpetrators




Record-creation event


Statistical properties of the original victim data without representing actual victims











Observation and Scope






Unit of observation






Population or objects represented


victims and perpetrators




Time period covered


2005 to 2022.




Geographic area coverage


123 countries and territories











Variables and Data Structure






Main variables/fields


Victim gender, Perpetuator gender, Relationship.




Data types included


Categorical, numerical




Direct measurements


Year,Region, number exploiter, money transfer.




Possible proxy variables


All











Documentation






Documentation found


Metadata, coding guide, abstract




Stated collection details


Yes, included details
